integrity: The result is a direct mathematical proof of the specified fiber scheme. Finite arithmetic checks corroborate selected cases but do not replace the all-prime proof. Historical priority is qualified and independent mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only split abelian surfaces with ordinary first elliptic factor, specified invariant fields, reduced polar divisors of degree at least two, and the explicitly defined restricted-Lie p-closed subscheme. This does not determine all other foliation moduli scheme structures, nonsplit extensions or automorphism-quotient isomorphism classes.
title: Finite \(p\)-closed foliation fibers: étale versus infinitesimal
